title: Gerçek ilan arama ve detay akışını bağlama
description: REQ-JOB-LIVE-001: Replace the `/ilan-ara` demo-only result source with validated public `job_posts` results and make database-backed job slugs open a real detail page while preserving current demo-slug behavior and the existing CV application flow. Use only evidenced columns from `job_posts` (`id`, `company_id`, `title`, `slug`, `summary`, `description`, `location`, `employment_type`, `remote_policy`, `salary_min`, `salary_max`, `currency`, `is_featured`, `published_at`, `expires_at`) and public company fields (`company_name`, `slug`, `logo_url`). Enforce active/published/not-expired visibility for search and details. Wire search and pagination to the real API; apply only filters with verified column semantics and do not silently pretend unsupported sector, permit, B3, urgent, lodging, ATS, or analytics filters work. Render only actual DB data; do not fabricate defaults or metrics. Add accessible loading/error/empty states and correct localized labels/messages in tr/en/ru/he. Keep the anon/RLS Supabase client and never use the service-role key. Preserve the existing CV upload-before-application and candidate-owned storage path validation in the assigned detail page. Do not add a database migration or new dependency. OpenCode is the sole writer and must leave changes uncommitted.
acceptanceCriteria: Real DB-backed jobs render in /ilan-ara from GET /api/ilanlar; search/pagination and backed filters produce matching results, while unsupported filters are not shown as applied; malformed DB rows/API failures show explicit error rather than demo/empty success; active/published/expiry constraints hold on list and detail; DB slug renders its real job data and metadata without breaking demo slug pages or CV application; all new text exists in tr/en/ru/he; npm run kalite and npm run build pass; no dependency/migration/secret exposure; OpenCode does not commit.
